description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Direction No. 58 - Directing all Private Healthcare Institutions to include information of all drugs and devices issued, in their receipts w.e.f. 01.07.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 10(1)(a) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements for private healthcare institutions regarding billing practices, making it a legal/regulatory instrument. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
